referenceSources.description:
A black 1998 Hyundai Coupe F2 is parked on an asphalt lot beside a brick wall and wooden fence. The coupe’s smooth, aerodynamic bodywork and tinted windows emphasize its sporty design. It rides on factory DTM-style alloy wheels, each bearing an "F2" center cap, underscoring its original factory condition.

Photographed in October 2004 by Johnny Moda and shared by Mel Spencer, this image is freely licensed for sharing and adaptation under attribution and share-alike terms. The car’s glossy paint reflects the surrounding environment, showcasing its well-maintained exterior.
